name: The Long Pour
overview: The Long Pour is a late 1920s New York Prohibition-era crime drama following the Italian-American Rinaldi family, who quietly control one of the city’s most sophisticated bootlegging empires. Led by Don Salvatore “Tore” Rinaldi, his wife, and his 5 sons, the family profits by maintaining and controlling Prohibition and carefully balancing supply, scarcity, and corruption to keep illegal alcohol highly lucrative.
